Authors

Notes live in git. You write a markdown file, you put your handle in the frontmatter, you push (or open a PR). That is the CMS. No CMS.

Path: sites/tharavad/src/content/blog/. Fields: title, date, summary, author. Plain text supremacy. If the site and the repo disagree, trust the repo.

Looking for maintainers and resident seats? That moved to The house — crew + roster, not a LinkedIn carousel. Ship history: Ship log.

Got a seat? Land a note under your handle. We are not a sole-author brand kit. Members write. Git keeps score.
